regions.today: Persistent rain will continue to spread from the northwest this evening, turning heavy at times with light to moderate southwesterly winds.
regions.tonight: Rain will clear southeastwards tonight with isolated showers following. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 14 degrees in light to moderate southwest winds, increasing towards morning.
regions.tomorrow: A bright, blustery and fresh day with sunny spells and well scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in moderate to fresh westerly winds, easing later.
